verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨਾ ਦੇਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਰਤਨ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: ratanaa dhekhai sabh ko ratan paarakhoo viralaa koiee|

en.bdb: The jewels are beholden by all but the jeweller is any rare one who test checks the jewels.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੈ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸਮਝੈ ਵਿਰਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: raag naadh sabh ko sunai sabadh surat samajhai viraloiee|

en.bdb: All listen to the melody and rhythm but a rare one understands the mystery of Word consciousness,

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਮਾਲ ਪਰੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gursikh ratan padhaarathaa saadhasa(n)gat mil maal paroiee|

en.bdb: The Sikhs of the Guru are pearls who are strung in the garland in the form of congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਰਚਾ ਹੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: heerai heeraa bedhiaa sabadh surat mil parachaa hoiee|

en.bdb: Only his consciousness remains merged in the Word whose mind diamond remains cut by the diamond of Word, the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਣੈ ਸੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham gur govi(n)dh sin(j)aanai soiee|

en.bdb: The fact that the transcendental Brahm is the prefect Brahm and the Guru is God, is only identified by a gurmukh, the Guru-orientated one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਘਰੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਜਾਣੁ ਜਣੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal sahaj ghar piram piaalaa jaan janoiee|

en.bdb: Only gurmukhs enter the abode of inner knowledge to attain fruits of delight and only they know the delight of the cup of love and make others also know it.
Then the Guru and the disciple become identical.
